external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Novartis is a founding member of The Future of Workforce Health Initiative led by Harvard Medical School. It aims to identify cutting-edge solutions and practices for improving employee health and productivity, with a focus on enhancing mental health and wellbeing.
Novartis partnered with London School of Economics, University of Zurich and MoreThanNow in academic research to inform ‘Mental Health First Aider’ programs.

Novartis Slovenia joined UNICEF Slovenia in raising awareness of mental health in children and adolescents.

Novartis Foundation is in collaboration with Canton of Basel-Stadt and the University of Basel to support the population cohort study COVCO+ which aims to better understand the biological and environmental factors that influence healthy living, incl. mental health conditions.

network.coverage_note: Novartis is a pharmaceutical company, not an educational institution, so it does not have a standard Erasmus+ mobility program or a list of academic partners. The listed partners are academic or research collaborators.
